description.en: OpenCode Zen prepaid balance and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 OpenCode Zen 预付余额与模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and, optionally, a console cookie for balance refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新余额的控制台 Cookie。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the auth cookie from opencode.ai to refresh the Zen balance. The plugin discovers the workspace automatically.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 opencode.ai 粘贴 auth Cookie，用于刷新 Zen 余额；插件会自动发现工作区。

help_text.en: Optional. Pin balance refresh to a workspace and skip auto-discovery.
help_text.zh: 可选。将余额刷新固定到某个工作区，跳过自动发现。
